actual_usage.point_comparison: Positive radii away from the discontinuity; check density, radial velocity, pressure and specific internal energy.
actual_usage.cell_average_comparison: Split each radial shell at the shock location reported by ExactPack, integrate unmodified point values with Gauss-Legendre quadrature in r^(d-1)dr, and compare conserved cell averages and volume-average pressure with the independent local reference.
actual_usage.scope: An independent implementation cross-check of the analytic reference, not a second Euler PDE computation or a full ExactPack test-suite run. Geometry=3 reference checks do not by themselves establish a spherical numerical-solver result.

limitations.detail: At the pinned code, shock location and density depend on gamma but pressure is rho0*u0^2*4^geometry/3. Hence external pressure comparison is restricted to gamma=5/3. General-gamma pressure must instead satisfy p2=(gamma-1)*rho0*((gamma+1)/(gamma-1))^geometry*u0^2/2.
Upstream jump metadata includes 4^(geometry-1) and velocity -1, so it is not used as a general-parameter independent jump reference.
Avoid r=0 because np.where evaluates an upstream 1/r expression, and avoid exact jump points because the trace convention is not a unique physical point value.
